question.text: Information about the custodian of a mutual fund's assets would be found in which document?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p103, the SAI gives complete details of mutual fund constituents and service providers, including Custodian, Registrar and Transfer Agent, Statutory Auditor, Fund Accountant, and Collecting Bankers. p95 confirms the SAI's role as the document for AMC-level statutory and operational information. The Trap: The SID focuses on scheme-specific information, not AMC-level service-provider details. KIM is a summary. Fact Sheets contain portfolio and performance data. Note: When evaluating where MF assets are held, the SAI is the right document for custodian and other service-provider details listed on p103.
